  def g(s: Any): Int =
    s match
      case Array(a: Int, _@_*) => a

Infix star extractor patterns (sloplint SC-INSTAR)
================================================================================

object Test:
  case class *(a: Int, b: Int)
  case class P(a: Int, b: Any)
  def m(p: P, v: *): Unit =
    val x * y = v
    val P(a, b * c) = p
    println(a)
